## Feature Description
A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it useful?

## Proposed Solution
How do you envision this feature working?

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## Use Case
Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be helpful.

## Screenshots/Mockups
If applicable, add mockups or examples of how this might look.

## Additional Context
Any other context or information about the feature request.
